name: Alerta
description: Alert management console that consolidates and deduplicates alerts from monitoring tools like Prometheus and Zabbix.

envVars.description: Secret key used to sign Alerta sessions and tokens
Password for the Alerta PostgreSQL database user

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_URL: "postgres://alerta:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/alerta"
      ALERTA_SECRET_KEY: {{env.ALERTA_SECRET_KEY}}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/app/config
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:15
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: alerta
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: alerta
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
